# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_run = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	bag_wtp_collect_candidates = yes
	bag_wtp_rebuild_browse = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_clear = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_prepare = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_score = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rights }
		bag_wtp_plan_place_rights = yes
	}
	bag_wtp_plan_allocate = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_build = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	cmf_log = { action = bag_wtp_log_plan }
}

# What the last plan left on the map.
#
# `_plan_touched` is every location the last run wrote anything to, its own
# province's neighbours included. **`bag_wtp_force_town` and `_force_rural` -- the player's own
# "count this one as a town" -- is deliberately not among the things removed**:
# it is an answer he gave, not one the plan computed.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_clear = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rank
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prank
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_town_n
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rural_n
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_load
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_load
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_town
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_rural
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_touched
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provn value = 0 }

# Every province of the chosen ground, made ready, once each.
#
# **Every counter the allocation reads has to exist on every location it can
# reach before the first round.** A comparison against a variable that is not
# there is the failure that logs nothing -- and it is not enough to prepare the
# candidates, because a good added to a province is written onto *all* of that
# province's locations, candidates or not.
#
# The province is reached through the first of its candidates and the rest of
# them fall out on the dirty flag, so this is one pass per province rather than
# one per location. That first candidate is the province's stand-in afterwards:
# `_plan_prov_locs` is one location per province and is what the ranking walks.

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_prepare = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_dirty } }
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dirty value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town_n value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rural_n value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_load value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = 9999 }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
					clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_town
					clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_rural
					clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
					add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
				}
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provn add = 1 }
		}
	}
	bag_wtp_plan_count_rooms = yes
}

# The capacity of the chosen ground: every candidate's cap, added up. Under the
# province model it is also what a finished plan should come to, so «мест»
# against «зданий» is a completeness reading. `_plan_towns` beside it is how many
# of the candidates the plan counts as built-up -- the first thing to look at if
# a plan comes back empty, because 0 or all of them says the rank test is the
# fault and nothing else can.
#
# The two caps arrive through their `_show_` script values rather than as
# `add = global_var:`: `add` takes a script value for certain, and everything
# else about the bare form is inference.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_count_rooms = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
		}
	}
}

# clay: keep both sides, then divide the ground by the better of them, so that
# 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good alike. A good
# nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# **The method that won is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good
# and not the recipe, so keeping it would be one more variable per good per
# location -- 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ordmax1
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# **The method that won is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good
# and not the recipe, so keeping it would be one more variable per good per
# location -- 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_7 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p7 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr7 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ordmax7
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p7 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p7 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr7 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr7 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# horses: keep both sides, then divide the ground by the better of them, so that

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ordmax20
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# sugar: keep both sides, then divide the ground by the better of them, so that
# 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good alike. A good
# nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# **The method that won is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good
# and not the recipe, so keeping it would be one more variable per good per
# location -- 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_21 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p21 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr21 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }

		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax21 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p33 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p33 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr33 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr33 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# jewelry: keep both sides, then divide the ground by the better of them, so that
# 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good alike. A good
# nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# **The method that won is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good
# and not the recipe, so keeping it would be one more variable per good per
# location -- 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_34 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p34 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr34 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ordmax34
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax34 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p34 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p34 multiply = 1000 }

			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p46 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr46 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# weaponry: keep both sides, then divide the ground by the better of them, so that
# 1000 means "the province this good wants most" for every good alike. A good
# nothing in this ground can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# **The method that won is deliberately not kept.** A plan row prints the good
# and not the recipe, so keeping it would be one more variable per good per
# location -- 47 of them on every candidate -- that nothing reads.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_47 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_ordmax47
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = bag_wtp_ordmax47 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# Divided before it is scaled and never after: the top of the ground is
			# already a scaled number, and multiplying first would ask the engine's
			# fixed point for a million. One divisor for both sides, so the village
			# keeps its honest fifth of the workshop.
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 multiply = 1000 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 divide = bag_wtp_plan_top_value }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 multiply = 1000 }
		}
	}
}

# One good, onto every location of the province in hand.
#
# Called in the province's own scope. Both sides are separate lists and separate
# counters, and both are written to every location so that the allocation can ask
# its questions of whatever candidate the ordered walk hands it.
# Scope: province_definition
bag_wtp_plan_add_town_1 = {
	every_location_in_province_definition = {
		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town target = goods:clay }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town_n add = 1 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_lists add = 1 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
}

		add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rural target = goods:cotton }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rural_n add = 1 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_lists add = 1 }

# Urban rights, before any good touches a town list.
#
# **A right is chosen per province, not by rights taking turns.** There are
# 12 of them and rarely that many provinces in a plan, so an order over rights
# would decide the whole outcome by its own arbitrariness. Asked the other way
# round -- which right does this ground suit best -- every province gets the
# answer that is true about it, and the rights that go unused are the ones no
# ground here wanted.
#
# One location per province, from `_plan_prov_locs`, and only where the province
# has somewhere built-up to put a right at all.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_place_rights = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_has_town = yes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 0 }
		# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights: cloth, fine_cloth, silk
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 1 }
		}
		# royal_artisan_rights: furniture, leather, pottery
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 2 }
		}
		# royal_book_rights: books, dyes, paper
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 3 }
		}
		# royal_brewing_rights: beer, liquor, wine
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 4 }
		}
		# royal_jewelry_rights: jewelry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 5 }
		}
		# royal_masonry_rights: glass, masonry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq6 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 2
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 6 }
		}
		# royal_naval_rights: naval_supplies, tar
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq7 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 2
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 7 }
		}
		# royal_textile_rights: cloth, dyes, fine_cloth
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq8 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 8 }
		}
		# royal_tooling_rights: tools
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq9 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 9 }
		}
		# royal_weaponry_rights: cannons, firearms, weaponry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq10 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 3
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 10 }
		}
		# scandinavian_bergslag_privileges: tools
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq11 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 1
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 11 }
		}
		# scandinavian_tar_privileges: naval_supplies, tar
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq12 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban >= 2
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 1 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_29 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_30 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_18 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 2 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_32 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_36 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_42 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 3 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_27 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_4 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_40 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 4 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_26 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_37 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_24 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 5 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_34 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 6 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_33 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_38 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 7 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_39 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_45 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 8 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_29 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_4 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_30 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 9 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_46 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 10 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_28 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_31 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_47 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 11 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_46 = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_rbest_k = 12 }
			province_definition = {
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_39 = yes
				bag_wtp_plan_add_town_45 = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# The rounds. Every good takes one town list and one village list, then every
# good takes another, until a whole sweep adds nothing anywhere.
#
# **It runs until the ground is full rather than for a fixed number of rounds.**
# The first build stopped after «зданий на товар» rounds and left a third of
# Wallachia empty at three; a location the plan can feed is never left empty,
# because what a displaced building leaves behind is exactly what should cascade
# into the poorer ground. The sweep counter is a guard against a condition that
# cannot be left, not a design: 12 sweeps is far past the point where the
# lists are full.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_allocate = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_sweeps value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_go = 1
			global_var:bag_wtp_plan_sweeps < 12
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_sweeps add = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_2 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_3 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_4 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_5 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_6 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_7 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_8 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_9 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_10 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_11 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_12 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_13 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_14 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_15 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_16 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_17 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_18 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_19 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_20 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_21 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_22 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_23 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_24 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_25 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_26 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_27 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_28 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_29 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_30 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_31 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_32 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_33 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_34 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_35 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_36 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_37 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_38 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_39 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_40 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_41 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_42 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_43 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_44 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_45 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_46 = yes
		bag_wtp_plan_pick_47 = yes
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_added = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# clay joins the town list and the village list of the province each side of it
# suits best, or neither.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a sweep over 47 goods twice is affordable. Every condition is a
# plain read off the candidate the walk is holding -- the province's counters and
# lists are mirrored onto all of its locations for exactly this reason.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_plan_town_n < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town target = goods:clay } }
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			province_definition = { bag_wtp_plan_add_town_1 = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_pr1 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_plan_rural_n < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rural target = goods:clay } }
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			province_definition = { bag_wtp_plan_add_rural_1 = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town target = goods:paper } }
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord40
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			province_definition = { bag_wtp_plan_add_town_40 = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_pn40 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_max
			}
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_pr40 > 0
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_plan_rural_n < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rural target = goods:paper } }
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr40
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			province_definition = { bag_wtp_plan_add_rural_40 = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# The province's answer, spent on its locations.
#
# Every location copies its own side's list -- which is already on it -- into the
# one list the window repeats over. That is what makes a province read as one
# answer and leaves nothing the ground can feed standing empty.
#
# Two locations of one province are not always able to build the same thing:
# terrain and a building's own requirements can rule one out. That is not asked
# here, and it is the next thing this pass owes.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_build = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		save_scope_as = bag_wtp_loc
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_plan_town
				save_scope_as = bag_wtp_good
				scope:bag_wtp_loc = {
					add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = scope:bag_wtp_good }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_plan_rural
				save_scope_as = bag_wtp_good
				scope:bag_wtp_loc = {
					add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = scope:bag_wtp_good }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = var:bag_wtp_load }
	}
}

# The rows: one per location that got anything, its province's locations together.
#
# **Provinces are ranked first and their locations follow.** Under the province
# model most locations of one province carry the same list, and a sort on the
# location's own load would tie nearly all of them -- `ordered_in_global_list`
# promises nothing about ties, so two provinces would interleave. The provinces
# are put in order by how much the plan put in each, every location is told its
# province's place, and the rows sort on that with a province's towns ahead of
# its villages.
#
# A province's load is added up through a global, because a walk over its
# locations cannot write back to the scope that started it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_rank = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count value = 0 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count add = var:bag_wtp_load }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_load value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_count }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_prov_order
		max = 400
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n add = 1 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_n }
			}
		}
	}
	# Counted before the rows are taken, and separately from them: the walk below
	# stops at 150 and a count that stopped with it would say the plan used
	# exactly as many locations as the window can draw, whatever it really used.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_order
		max = 150
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_ranked target = this }
	}
}

# The window's own list, filled on opening and emptied on closing -- the same
# contract as the other two windows and for the same reason: a scripted widget
# never comes down, so emptying the datamodel is the only thing that frees a row.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_show = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_rank_order
		max = bag_wtp_show_plan_shown
		check_range_bounds = no
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_results target = this }
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_hide = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
}

# The same thing the window's own scripted GUI does, reachable from an effect,
# because a Mod Menu button is script and script cannot reach the interface's
# variable system. The other two windows are closed on the way in: three tables
# of three different questions, and only one answers the button just pressed.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_plan_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_open value = 1 }
}
